intro.text: A group first mentioned when Kelsier talks in private with Sazed, the Terris steward who knows hundreds of religions.
Terris Feruchemists who store knowledge in their metalminds. They formed to remember everything after the Terris religion was lost, and Sazed is one of them.
A secret order of Terris Feruchemists, led by the Synod, who gathered knowledge in their metalminds and kept it hidden from the Lord Ruler.

description.text: Sazed believes the Lord Ruler fears the Keepers, thinking them something he does not understand.
The order was formed to remember everything after the Terris religion was lost, and each Keeper stores what they gather in metalminds.
The Keepers were ruled by the Synod and stayed hidden from the Lord Ruler, who would have had them killed for their Feruchemy.
They follow the old Worldbringers in collecting as much knowledge as they can.

items.text: Sazed planned to travel to Terris and share what he had learned with the other Keepers.
The Synod, the governing body of Terris, sent Keepers out to teach. Sazed taught rural skaa writing, farming, governing and medicine.
Another Keeper, the Terriswoman Tindwyl, came to Luthadel.
Sazed left his teaching to return to Luthadel against the Synod's orders, as he had once disobeyed them to help fight the Lord Ruler.
Steel Inquisitors came to Tathingdwen and killed the Synod, and Terris refugees fled toward Luthadel.
